episodes.title: The UFO Cult Study Psychology Believed for 70 Years Was Bent
episodes.description:
In 1954 a Chicago-area psychic predicted a world-ending flood, and three undercover psychologists turned her group into psychology's most famous story about people who refuse to change their minds. Thomas Kelly's paper 'Debunking When Prophecy Fails', built on Leon Festinger's newly unsealed papers, argues the group largely gave up while the researchers steered events. We compare how the psychic and the scientists each handled being wrong, and include the critics who say Kelly overreaches. Cognitive dissonance theory itself is not overturned: it rests on later lab experiments, which are still being tested today.
